title: Modularity as the bridge that killed FLT
summary: Not elementary number theory alone: Frey→Ribet→modularity contradiction. Elliptic curves and modular forms share matching a_p sequences when modularity holds.

title: Modularity inside Langlands
summary: Modularity is one successful dictionary entry in the larger Langlands program (Rosetta between arithmetic and automorphic/analytic worlds).

title: 2025: modularity for a class of abelian surfaces
summary: Popular report (May 2025): four mathematicians, ~decade of work, intensive Bonn 2023 collaboration ('down the mine'), ~230-page proof that a natural class of abelian surfaces (higher-dimensional cousins of elliptic curves / genus-2 data) are modular in a suitable sense. Technical hinge: weak congruence matching (mod-2 vs mod-3 type arithmetic) bridged by a 2020 result (name garbled in ASR—verify literature).
math: Abelian surface modularity / Galois representations; compare elliptic modularity

title: Why it matters
summary: Opens paths toward arithmetic of abelian surfaces (including BSD-type dreams at higher dimension) and enlarges the Langlands territory beyond elliptic curves. Status: major modularity advance—not 'Langlands finished'.
